metadata.title: State APT catalog: the major nation-state hacking groups and their sponsors (China, Russia, DPRK, Iran, US)
metadata.frame: The first batch of the threat-actor catalog: the principal state-sponsored 'Advanced Persistent Threat' groups, each wired to its sponsoring intelligence/military service, the vendor/government that named or attributed it, and its signature operations. These are the espionage/sabotage branch of the malware lineage (distinct from criminal ransomware and commercial spyware).
metadata.grade: Group->sponsor links are ATTRIBUTIONS by governments (indictments, sanctions) and threat-intel vendors - high-confidence but attributions, not confessions. Signature operations (APT1 report, DNC hack, SolarWinds, NotPetya, Volt/Salt Typhoon) = FACT (Mandiant/CrowdStrike/DOJ/CISA). Unit designations (61398, 26165, 74455) are as-published.
metadata.honest_limits: Attribution is probabilistic: naming conventions differ per vendor (Fancy Bear = APT28 = Sofacy = Forest Blizzard), and a 'group' is a cluster of activity, not a fixed roster. This block records the WIDELY-ACCEPTED consensus attributions with their sources; it does not assert individual identities beyond public indictments. Aliases are consolidated to one node each to avoid double-counting.
metadata.method: Mandiant APT1 (2013); DOJ indictments (PLA 2014; GRU 2018/2020; APT29/SolarWinds); CrowdStrike 'Bear/Panda/Chollima' taxonomy; CISA advisories (Volt Typhoon 2023-24; Salt Typhoon 2024-25); ODNI/NCSC attributions.

edges.notes: APT1 = PLA Unit 61398 (Shanghai), exposed in Mandiant's landmark 2013 APT1 report; DOJ indicted 5 PLA officers in 2014 - the first public naming of a state military hacking unit and years of IP-theft espionage (fact/attribution).
Mandiant's APT1 report established the modern threat-intel naming/attribution playbook (fact).

APT28 (Fancy Bear / Sofacy / Forest Blizzard) = Russian military intelligence GRU (Unit 26165). Ops: 2016 DNC hack, WADA, TV5Monde, Bundestag; DOJ/Mueller indictments 2018 (fact/attribution). Aliases consolidated here.

APT29 (Cozy Bear / Midnight Blizzard / The Dukes) = Russian foreign-intel SVR. Ops: DNC (2015-16), COVID vaccine-research theft (2020), and the SolarWinds supply-chain campaign (fact/attribution). Aliases consolidated.

APT29 ran the SolarWinds 'Sunburst' supply-chain compromise (disclosed Dec-2020): a trojanized Orion update reached ~18,000 customers and was used to breach US agencies (Treasury, Commerce, DHS) + tech firms - the defining software-supply-chain espionage event (fact).
Sunburst breached multiple US federal agencies - the wake-up call behind EO 14028 (software supply-chain security, SBOMs) and the CISA/CDM push (fact).
The campaign also abused SAML token forgery ('Golden SAML') + Microsoft 365/Azure AD to move laterally into cloud tenants - implicating identity infrastructure, not just the Orion update (fact).

Sandworm = GRU Unit 74455. Ops: Ukraine power-grid blackouts (2015, 2016), NotPetya (2017), Olympic Destroyer (2018), Ukraine wartime wipers - the most destructive state cyber unit; DOJ indictment 2020 (fact/attribution).
Links the existing NotPetya node to its operator (Sandworm/GRU) - the EternalBlue-powered wiper (~$10B) (fact).

Sandworm's Ukraine grid attacks (BlackEnergy/Industroyer) are the only confirmed cyber-caused power blackouts - the template for critical-infrastructure sabotage (fact); wires the APT layer to the energy/grid thread.
Turla (Snake / Uroburos / Venomous Bear) = Russian FSB-linked; decades-long espionage (satellite C2, the Snake implant dismantled by the FBI's 'MEDUSA' operation 2023) (fact/attribution).

Volt Typhoon = PRC state-sponsored; living-off-the-land PRE-POSITIONING inside US critical infrastructure (power, water, comms, transport - incl. Guam) for potential disruption in a Taiwan crisis; CISA/NSA/FBI advisories 2023-24 (fact/attribution).

Volt Typhoon's focus on critical-infrastructure OT (not espionage but disruption-readiness) is the strategic shift that alarmed US officials - wiring the China-APT thread to the grid/critical-infra nodes (fact).

Salt Typhoon = PRC (MSS-linked); breached at least 9 US telecom carriers (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Lumen) incl. the LAWFUL-INTERCEPT/wiretap systems - a historic counterintelligence compromise (2024-25) (fact/attribution).
Wires Salt Typhoon to the existing telecom node - the carrier breaches exposed call/metadata + intercept infrastructure (fact); ties the China-APT thread to the telecom-carriers block.

Equation Group = NSA Tailored Access Operations (the most sophisticated known toolset: firmware implants, Stuxnet-linked tooling); exposed by Kaspersky (2015) and the Shadow Brokers leak - consolidates the US side of the APT ledger (fact/attribution).

Lazarus (Hidden Cobra) = DPRK (RGB). Uniquely REVENUE-driven: Sony 2014, WannaCry 2017, SWIFT bank heists (Bangladesh Bank $81M), and the largest crypto thefts (Ronin $625M, Bybit 2025) funding the regime (fact/attribution).
edges.source: #239 state-APT (US/UN attribution; UN Panel of Experts)

edges.notes: Kimsuky (APT43 / Velvet Chollima) = DPRK espionage - spear-phishing think-tanks, academics, and nuclear/foreign-policy targets; sanctioned by OFAC 2023 (fact/attribution).
APT35 (Charming Kitten / Mint Sandstorm) = Iran IRGC-linked; credential phishing of journalists, academics, dissidents, and 2020/2024 US election-adjacent targets (fact/attribution).
CrowdStrike's 'Bear' (Russia) / 'Panda' (China) / 'Chollima' (DPRK) / 'Kitten' (Iran) taxonomy is the other dominant naming system - here linking its Fancy Bear = APT28 identification (fact).

Anchors the state-ESPIONAGE/influence branch of the malware lineage (distinct from criminal ransomware + commercial spyware) - state services running persistent intrusion campaigns (fact of category).
Represents the newest branch: CRITICAL-INFRASTRUCTURE PRE-POSITIONING (readiness to disrupt, not steal) - the strategic evolution of state APT activity (interpretation/category).
